Both endpoints are in `src/app.mjs`, and `npm test` passes: 11 tests, including the 3 existing ones and 8 new ones I added to `test/app.test.mjs`.

- **`GET /api/categories/<path>`** returns the products whose category equals the path or sits below it. It matches on whole segments, so `electronics/audio/head` does not pick up `electronics/audio/headphones`. Paths not in `categories` in `src/catalog.mjs` return 404 `{ "error": "not_found" }`. A real category with no products returns 200 with an empty list.
- **`GET /api/products/:sku`** returns the product as JSON. A `.csv` suffix returns a `sku,name,price` header and the product's row. Unknown SKUs return the 404 JSON in both forms.

Choices I made:
- The CSV content type is `text/csv; charset=utf-8`. Express adds the charset to every string response, so it starts with `text/csv` but is not exactly `text/csv`.
- CSV fields containing commas, quotes, or line breaks are quoted per RFC 4180. The current catalog has none, so this only affects future data.
- The SKU lookup is exact and case-sensitive.
